status: Real-session replay extension specified after the synthetic study, before real-controller outcome evaluation; local protocol, not external preregistration
source: Official Caltech ACN-Data public export; all 2019 UTC acquisition windows with count verification
capacity_reference: Peak connected nominal power among eligible training sessions; artificial congestion, not measured feeder headroom
tariff: Original designed UTC tariff: USD 0.12/grid-kWh, USD 0.30 at hours >=21 or <1; not observed JPL prices
numerics: Same two-stage earliest-allocation tie-break for all five MPC variants using scripts.second_pass_diagnostics.lex_solver; 1e-7 objective allowance and 2e-7 acceptance; original action checks/fallback retained
selection: Within each policy, minimum validation tail subject to >=98% equal-share energy and <=103% equal-share cost/kWh; original delivery-deficit-first fallback. Primary comparator selected among equal, maxmin, debt_share, pf_mpc. Freeze before test. No Q3/Q4 retuning.
history_initialization: Zero separately at each validation/test period and capacity/policy; observed request revisions retained; no history transfer across periods
primary_metric: Mean of worst ceil(10% N) user-mean final-request shortfalls among users with >=5 sessions; users reranked separately by policy
uncertainty: Paired moving blocks of 5 observed site days, 2000 outcome-resampling replicates, seed 20260922. Recompute repeated-user eligibility and tails in each resample. Hold fitted model/settings and realized policy-specific histories fixed; conditional resampling interval, not independent-site inference. Block lengths 2 and 10 as sensitivity for primary comparison.

forecast_audit.aggregation: Average available landmarks within session, then sessions; report Q3 and Q4 separately; no forecast selection on test

normalization: Exact-timestamp revision-order adapter, then original conservative 15-minute normalization; exclude missing identities/requests, ambiguous records, cross-local-day sessions and overlapping same-port sessions; log exclusions. Never substitute delivered energy for requests.
real_vs_modeled: Arrivals, departures, identities and timestamped user requests are recorded. Alternative policy delivery/cost/shortfall are simulated under common simplified physics. Historical observed departures and requests are held fixed despite counterfactual charging.
exclusions: unrecorded sessions or excluded-session background load
privacy: Raw records, normalized sessions, model user summaries and per-session results remain under ignored data/ paths. Only aggregates, source URLs, checksums, protocol and code are distributable artifacts. No reidentification.
